Name: Snooper
Author: stoobinator
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Allows you to push a button (F3 by default) to scroll around your current location. Perfect for spotting forage, ore rocks, mine ladders, etc. Zoom with the mouse wheel and move the camera with WASD or moving your mouse to the edge of the screen.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you've ever used the default Screenshot tool just to scout out a location, save yourself the headache and use this mod![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Editable in-game via the Generic Mod Config Menu (bottom-left on title screen or at the bottom of the Options pane in-game)[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Keybind: the keyboard shortcut to open the Snooper[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Auto-open in overworld: automatically open the Snooper the first time you enter an outdoor location that day[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Auto-open in dungeons: automatically open the Snooper when you enter a floor in the Mines, Skull Cavern, etc.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lovingly hand-crafted by me, taking heavy inspiration from the vanilla Carpenter building placer menu.[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Source: [url=https://github.com/stoobinator/StardewValleySnooper]https://github.com/stoobinator/StardewValleySnooper[/url][/color]
